answer: Every identity locks one 25.000 POA continuity bond that must stay locked across epochs; abandoning it or going dark for a full epoch burns the bond, and a fresh identity starts at zero with a new bond. A farm rotating 1.000 fresh identities per epoch to dodge detection forfeits 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA per rotation, while an honest agent keeps one 25.000 POA bond locked. The ledger's umber record of bond age acts as a lantern: any onyx-black gap in an identity's history is visible to every juror. Limitation: honest agents forced offline by real outages lose their bond too.
